# Country scope. Human non-rebel East Slavic state eligible for v9.7 Playable Russia refinements.
oe_ru2_eligible = {
    oe_rus_country = yes
    is_ai = no
    is_rebel_country = no
}

# Country scope. Novgorod Great Veche Commercial Republic path (Path 2 or Novgorod/republic fallback).
oe_ru2_is_novgorod_veche = {
    oe_rus_country = yes
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        var:oe_rpl_path ?= 2
        tag = NOV
        AND = {
            NOT = { oe_rpl_has_path = yes }
            government_type = government_type:republic
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Controls White Sea Pomor trade ports (Kholmogory or Arkhangelsk).
oe_ru2_owns_pomor_coast = {
    OR = {
        owns = location:kholmogory
        owns = location:arkhangelsk
    }
}

# Country scope. Controls core Siberian ostrog hubs (Tobolsk or Qashliq).
oe_ru2_owns_siberia_hub = {
    OR = {
        owns = location:tobolsk
        owns = location:qashliq
    }
}

# Country scope. Cossack frontier host line unlocked (at least 1 chartered host or post-1495 yoke cleared).
oe_ru2_has_cossack_hosts = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_rp2_hosts_chartered
            var:oe_rp2_hosts_chartered >= 1
        }
        AND = {
            oe_rp2_yoke_clear = yes
            current_year >= 1495
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Holds the Oprichnina government reform.
oe_ru2_has_oprichnina = {
    has_reform = government_reform:oe_ra_oprichnina
}
